name: Independent Block Encoding
aliases: Independent Block Encoding with Transform Models
definition: A local encoding pass that works independently on blocks, potentially using information gathered during a global step (e.g., learned dictionaries). It is often applied within a multiresolution framework encoding blocks at various resolution levels obtained by digital filtering and subsampling.
summary: Independent Block Encoding compresses volumetric data by dividing it into sub-blocks encoded separately, ensuring memory usage remains independent of the total input size.
